nodes.description: Ownable.owner: address holding privileged control, written from msg.sender in the constructor.
Pausable.paused: emergency stop flag read by whenNotPaused and whenPaused.
edCoreContract: address of EDCoreInterface used for all external calls (mutable by owner).
checkpointLevel = 4; level at which half the entrance fee is refunded.
breakevenLevel = 8; level at which another half of the entrance fee is refunded.
jackpotLevel = 12; level at which the player wins half the jackpot.
dungeonDifficulty = 3; used when computing super hero power boost.
monsterHealth = 10; base health per monster level.
monsterStrength = 4; added to monster level for flee damage.
monsterFleeTime = 8 minutes; timing window for monster attacks/flee.
entranceFee = 0.04 ether; required to start a run, owner settable.
jackpot: accumulated pot paid out at jackpotLevel.
entranceFeePool: pool of collected entrance fees before moving into the jackpot.
_seed: private PRNG state used by _getRandomNumber.
heroIdToMonster: mapping of hero ID to its current Monster struct.
heroIdToHealth: mapping of hero ID to remaining hero health.
heroIdToRefundedFee: mapping of hero ID to already refunded entrance fee.
Ownable() constructor: assigns msg.sender to owner.
transferOwnership(address newOwner) onlyOwner: hands ownership to a new address.
pause() onlyOwner whenNotPaused: sets paused = true.
unpause() onlyOwner whenPaused: sets paused = false.
destroy() onlyOwner: selfdestructs and sends balance to owner.
destroyAndSend(address _recipient) onlyOwner: selfdestructs to a caller supplied address.
getGameSettings(): read-only aggregation of all DungeonRunBeta settings.
getRunDetails(uint _heroId): view function computing hero/monster state from now and core contract data.
attack(uint _heroId) whenNotPaused onlyHumanAddress payable: main payable entrypoint paying fees and triggering damage resolution.
setEdCoreContract(address): onlyOwner replacement of the external core contract address.
setEntranceFee(uint): onlyOwner update of entranceFee without bounds checks.
_attack(...) internal: resolves monster and hero damage, rewards, jackpot accounting and external transfers.
_getRandomNumber(uint _upper) private: weak PRNG based on _seed, blockhash, coinbase and difficulty.
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner); access control gate.
whenNotPaused modifier: require(!paused);
whenPaused modifier: require(paused);
onlyHumanAddress modifier: extcodesize(msg.sender) == 0 check, bypassable by contract constructors.
msg.sender: attacker controlled caller used for ownership, refunds and payouts.
block.timestamp (now): miner influenceable time used for flee/death windows.
selfdestruct(owner) inside destroy(): irreversibly removes the contract and forwards its balance.
selfdestruct(_recipient) inside destroyAndSend(): forwards all balance to an owner-chosen address.
msg.sender.transfer(msg.value - entranceFee) inside attack(): external call to the caller before accounting is finalised.
msg.sender.transfer(msg.value) inside attack(): unconditional refund on non-first attacks.
msg.sender.transfer(rewards) inside _attack(): pays refunds/jackpot before the run state is settled.
entranceFeePool += entranceFee: unchecked 0.4.x addition that can overflow the pool.
jackpot += addToJackpot: unchecked addition derived from refund bookkeeping.
entranceFeePool -= addToJackpot: unchecked subtraction that can underflow the pool.
heroIdToHealth[_heroId] -= damageByMonster: unchecked subtraction of a computed damage.
damageByHero = (_heroStrength * 1e9 + heroPower * 1e9 / (10 * rand)) / tx.gasprice: gas price dependent, division by zero possible when tx.gasprice == 0.
_seed = keccak256(_seed, blockhash, coinbase, difficulty): miner-influenceable weak randomness.
_heroId parameter of attack().
_genes parameter of _attack().
_heroStrength parameter of _attack().
_heroCurrentHealth parameter of _attack().
_upper parameter bounding _getRandomNumber().
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership().
_recipient parameter of destroyAndSend().
_newEdCoreContract parameter of setEdCoreContract().
_newEntranceFee parameter of setEntranceFee().
_heroId parameter of getRunDetails().
heroInitialHealth local derived from hero genes in attack().
heroStrength local derived from hero genes in attack().
monster memory/storage reference used across attack paths.
currentLevel local mirroring monster.level.
heroCurrentHealth local mirroring heroIdToHealth[_heroId].
dungeonRunEnded flag derived from timestamps, health and refund state.
addToJackpot = entranceFee - heroIdToRefundedFee[_heroId].
damageByHero local computed with gas price and randomness.
damageByMonster local from flee damage or PRNG.
heroPower local returned by edCoreContract.getHeroPower.
rewards local paid out at checkpoint/breakeven/jackpot levels.
isMonsterDefeated flag deciding reward and damage branches.
size local holding extcodesize(msg.sender) in onlyHumanAddress.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner inside the Ownable constructor.
Constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the stored owner.
owner is the reference value used in the onlyOwner comparison.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
pause is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
unpause is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
destroy is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
destroyAndSend is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setEdCoreContract is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setEntranceFee is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
pause is gated by whenNotPaused.
attack is gated by whenNotPaused, so pausing blocks gameplay.
unpause is gated by whenPaused.
attack is gated by onlyHumanAddress which relies on extcodesize.
onlyHumanAddress inspects msg.sender with extcodesize.
The extcodesize result is compared against zero in onlyHumanAddress.
newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership.
transferOwnership rewrites the owner state variable.
destroy executes selfdestruct(owner).
owner receives the whole balance destroyed by selfdestruct.
_recipient parameter flows into destroyAndSend.
destroyAndSend executes selfdestruct(_recipient).
The owner-supplied recipient receives all contract funds.
getRunDetails uses now to classify the dungeon run game state.
getRunDetails queries the core contract for hero details and power.
getRunDetails reads heroIdToHealth.
getRunDetails reads heroIdToMonster.
_heroId selects which hero run details are returned.
attack uses msg.sender to verify hero ownership and to refund.
attack calls edCoreContract.getHeroDetails for genes and owner.
attack loads the current monster from heroIdToMonster.
attack reads the stored hero current health.
attack measures monster flee and run-end windows with now.
attack requires msg.value >= entranceFee before starting a run.
_heroId selects the hero used in the attack.
entranceFee is added into entranceFeePool when a run starts.
entranceFeePool accumulates the entrance fee without overflow checks.
Unchecked pool increment can overflow entranceFeePool.
Pool accounting executes inside attack before run state is finalised.
Excess ether is refunded to msg.sender via transfer.
transfer() forwards gas and can re-enter attack before state settles.
Unused msg.value is refunded to msg.sender via transfer on later attacks.
Refund transfer can re-enter attack during fee/jackpot accounting.
attack reads heroIdToRefundedFee when computing the jackpot contribution.
entranceFee bounds addToJackpot in the jackpot update.
Already refunded fee is subtracted from entranceFee to compute addToJackpot.
Unchecked addition inflates the jackpot state variable.
Unchecked subtraction from entranceFeePool can underflow.
attack delegates damage resolution to the internal _attack.
_heroId is forwarded from attack into _attack.
genes is forwarded from attack into _attack.
heroStrength is forwarded from attack into _attack.
heroCurrentHealth is forwarded from attack into _attack.
dungeonRunEnded, derived from now, decides whether _attack runs.
dungeonRunEnded is computed from miner influenceable timestamps and run flags.
_attack loads the storage monster from heroIdToMonster.
_attack compares now against monster.creationTime + monsterFleeTime.
monsterStrength is used for flee damage computation.
_getRandomNumber returns pseudo random damage values for _attack.
Weakly random value feeds damageByMonster and damageByHero.
damageByMonster is computed inside _attack.
The damage formula divides by tx.gasprice, which the caller influences and which may be zero.
The gas price dependent result becomes damageByHero.
heroStrength is an operand of the damage formula.
Hero health is reduced with an unchecked subtraction.
heroIdToHealth is decremented by damageByMonster.
Unchecked subtraction can underflow the stored hero health.
jackpot is updated from the non-refunded fee inside _attack.
entranceFeePool is reduced when the fee moves to the jackpot.
isMonsterDefeated determines the reward branch inside _attack.
Rewards are paid out with transfer inside _attack.
Rewards are sent to msg.sender by an external transfer call.
The computed rewards amount is transferred to the player.
transfer() can re-enter _attack before health/jackpot state settles.
checkpointLevel is compared to the current level for refunds.
breakevenLevel is compared to the current level for refunds.
jackpotLevel decides the jackpot payout branch.
monsterHealth scales the newly created monster health.
_attack calls edCoreContract.getHeroPower for hero power.
_attack credits heroIdToRefundedFee with checkpoint rewards without checks.
New pseudo-random seed overwrites the _seed state variable.
Previous seed feeds the keccak256 PRNG input.
Weak PRNG state determines the returned random number.
_seed write is the only entropy source for the random number.
_upper bounds the modulo result and a zero upper reverts.
whenNotPaused reads the paused flag.
whenPaused reads the paused flag.
pause sets paused to true.
unpause sets paused to false.
Owner controls the core contract address, redirecting all external calls.
setEdCoreContract replaces the edCoreContract state variable.
entranceFee can be set to an arbitrary value with no upper bound.
setEntranceFee writes the unbounded entranceFee state variable.

attack derives heroInitialHealth from hero genes.
attack derives heroStrength from hero genes.
attack copies the monster struct into memory.
attack stores monster.level in currentLevel.
attack stores the stored hero health in heroCurrentHealth.
_attack computes addToJackpot from entranceFee minus refunded fee.
_attack stores the external hero power result in heroPower.
_attack computes rewards from level thresholds.

_attack computes damageByHero inside the unsafe operation.

normalization_plan.reason: _heroId is only a parameter of attack() and carries no independent state; fold it into attack.
_genes is only a parameter of _attack() used to query hero power; fold it into _attack.
_heroStrength is a transient parameter of _attack consumed by the damage formula.
_heroCurrentHealth is a transient parameter of _attack consumed by the health comparison.
_upper is a local bound used only by _getRandomNumber.
newOwner is the single parameter written by transferOwnership.
_recipient is the single parameter consumed by destroyAndSend.
_newEdCoreContract is the single parameter written by setEdCoreContract.
_newEntranceFee is the single parameter written by setEntranceFee.
_heroId is only a lookup key for getRunDetails().
heroInitialHealth is a transient local computed inside attack.
heroStrength is a transient local computed inside attack.
monster is a storage/memory alias manipulated inside _attack.
currentLevel mirrors monster.level within _attack.
heroCurrentHealth mirrors heroIdToHealth within attack.
dungeonRunEnded is a transient control flag computed in attack.
addToJackpot is a transient intermediate of the jackpot accounting in _attack.
damageByHero is a transient result of the unsafe damage formula in _attack.
damageByMonster is a transient result of the monster damage branch in _attack.
heroPower is a transient external call result used by _attack.
rewards is a transient payout amount transferred in _attack.
isMonsterDefeated is a transient branch flag in _attack.
size is a transient local holding extcodesize inside the onlyHumanAddress modifier.
